name: Time Clock
description: Displays the current date and time for the configured timezone.
project_description:
This module works as a Digital Time clock and shows the current date & time as per the country timezone set in admin configuration.

 Features 
 This module provides a block available in the block layout section of theme. We have also options to set time format in 12 or 24 hours and show date in different types too.

 Reasons to use 
 
 A live clock on the website header, footer, or any block 
 Both 12-hour and 24-hour time formats available 
 Option to display the current date in popular formats as well 
 Lightweight alternative to custom code 
 No external dependencies or libraries 
 
 Configuration 
 
 Install & enable the module as usual. 
 Go to the admin page "Structure >> Block Layout" and enable the relevant block "Time Clock" in a region. 
 Set the desired values in the block configuration. 
 Now, a current date & time will be visible there. 
 
 Additional requirements 
 This module requires no modules outside of Drupal core.
